narration: Welcome to the Wood Carving & Musical Instruments gallery. This is a 19th‑century Rudra Veena, accession number NM 66.3/1, a large stick zither crafted from wood with two gourd resonators and metal strings. It was a favorite of Dhrupad singers, whose slow, meditative compositions rely on the instrument’s deep, sustained resonance. Though rare today, it remains a living link to North India’s rich musical heritage.
